cover.title: Can AI agents really use apps?

slides.myth: AI agents just chat with you.
slides.fact: They actually use apps and websites to gather data and make decisions.

slides.myth: AI agents can’t write or run code.
slides.fact: Many AI agents generate and execute code to solve tasks automatically.

slides.myth: AI agents work completely on their own.
slides.fact: They use external tools but need human-designed instructions and prompts.

slides.heading: AI agents are powerful tool users
slides.body: They combine apps, websites, and code to plan and act on tasks.
